2. M: Add the repo-release-review skill's recipe-coupling check: warn when a repo layout changes under an existing bioconda recipe before tagging.

## recommendation

1. M: When pushing structural repo changes (layout, license paths) on a bioconda-packaged repo, check the recipe's build.sh for hardcoded paths in the same change.
2. L: Consider making build.sh layout-agnostic only if the layout is expected to change again; the explicit path is otherwise clearer.
